reviewText: Best strategy game I have played in a long time. Replacing the dice with cards makes so much sense for a puzzle lover like me!
Interesting concept blending Ludo with Rummy runs, but rounds can drag on when everyone keeps hoarding tiles for safe zones. Highlighting feature helps avoid missteps though.
Bhai opponent ke token pe land karke card chori karne wala feature bohot fun hai! Offline AI mode bhi mast challenging hai without internet. Good smooth gameplay.

Replacing dice with numbered cards is honestly a genius move, no more losing just because of bad luck. The split screen setup works smoothly on my phone. Just wish the sequence shortcut animation was a little faster, but really creative hybrid concept.
Bahut sahi game hai. Especially the tile-stealing mechanic when landing on opponents, it adds such a nice competitive edge to the Ludo board.
Runs smooth on my old Redmi phone without any heating issues. The graphics are clean and the UI doesn't clutter the screen during matches.
Really enjoy the offline AI mode when I am traveling. It's a great brain teaser, though I wish there were more custom token skins to unlock.
Concept is unique but the learning curve is a bit steep for casual players. Took me a while to stop trying to roll dice out of habit.
